purpose: Teach: 練馬/ニンテンドー/ローリング/ヤフオク/ホモ/シャロン/スタミナ/チャンピオンズ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、練馬区だったな
lines.en: Riku, your place was in Nerima, right?
lines.style: Playful accusation, half-teasing. Quick rhythm. She's cataloguing things she knows about him, enjoying catching him out. Light, testing tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ニンテンドーの新作買ったろ?桜
lines.en: You bought that new Nintendo game, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Casual counter-attack. Matter-of-fact delivery, slightly amused. He's turning the tables — met her observation with one of his own. Unruffled.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ローリング・ストーンズのTシャツ着てたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you wearing that Rolling Stones T-shirt.
lines.style: Lighter now, almost conversational. She's enjoying the back-and-forth. Comfortable. The observation feels like affection disguised as mockery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ヤフオクで限定品買ってたな、桜
lines.en: You bought limited-edition stuff on Yahoo Auctions, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Steady, knowing. He's keeping pace with her. No defensiveness — just matching her energy, observation for observation. Slightly smug.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、生物でホモ・サピエンス習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you learned about Homo sapiens in biology class, right?
lines.style: Shift to something more pointed. Still teasing but there's an edge now. Testing whether he catches the implication. Faster rhythm, slight smirk in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でシャロン元首相習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You studied Sharon, the former prime minister, in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quick parry. He caught what she was doing and he's firing back with his own loaded observation. Slightly faster tempo. Playing her game.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、スタミナドリンク飲んでたな
lines.en: Riku, I've seen you drinking stamina drinks.
lines.style: Drier now. Less playful, more pointed. The accusation lands differently — moving away from cute observations toward something more real. Slight narrowing of tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、チャンピオンズリーグ全試合観てたな、桜
lines.en: You watched every Champions League match, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, close. Lean-in delivery. He's seen her too. The teasing has become intimate — these aren't random things, they're proof he's been paying attention. Almost confessional.
